component.name: Snapline
component.summary: Region screenshots with annotation and upload

description.p: Press a hotkey, drag over the part of the screen you want, mark it up, then copy it, save it, print it or upload it and get a link in your clipboard.

ul.li: Pen, line, arrow, rectangle, circle, marker, text and blur tools with undo/redo
Copy, save, print, or upload to Imgur or your own server
Share links and reverse image search
Works on X11 and Wayland (GNOME, KDE, Sway, Hyprland), multi-monitor and HiDPI
Fix "The desktop refused the screenshot request" on GNOME: Snapline now opens a window to ask for screenshot permission once
Hotkey launches keep a normal app name, so GNOME remembers the screenshot permission
Windows raised from a hotkey or notification come to the front on Wayland
If the screenshot portal does not answer within 5 seconds, grim or Flameshot is used instead
Upload settings and history are now readable only by you (they can hold API tokens and private links)
Notifications show links and file names containing & or < correctly
Upload error messages from servers are always shown as plain text
Oversized replies from upload servers are refused
The instance socket ignores malformed input and uses a per-user name outside the runtime directory
GNOME shortcuts work for app paths containing spaces or quotes
Move, edit, recolour, resize and delete annotations after drawing them
Hotkeys set in Settings now work on GNOME, including Print
